verdict.rationale: Insomnia's design mode lets you build/iterate on OpenAPI specs, view a generated preview, get linting and auto-generated code snippets in 12+ languages, which serves as a form of documentation generation from specs (insomnia-docs-5, insomnia-docs-16, insomnia-docs-17, insomnia-docs-18). However, there is no evidence of a dedicated 'publish' feature (e.g., hosting a documentation site or public API reference) — only in-app preview and collaborative editing via Git are documented. Missing for 10: a documented publish/export-to-hosted-docs capability, evidence of turning collections (not just specs) into shareable documentation, and any independent confirmation of a publishing workflow.
